OtaPayoutChannel.description: OTA that sent the payout. These are the channels that write into the collection today; a new one is added here and to the sync that writes it.

OtaPayoutStatus.description: Status of the payout in the OTA.

OtaPayoutMethod.description: How the OTA settles the payout.

OtaPayoutItem.description: Breakdown of a payout for a single reservation.

reservationPartnerCode.description: Partner code of the reservation, as the OTA prints it. The same code the reservation carries as `partnerCode`.

reservationIds.description: Reservations of this payout item in Stays. Empty when the payout was read before the reservation reached Stays, or when the OTA settles a reservation this account does not hold: the batch is stored whole either way, so its items keep adding up to the transfer.

reservationCodes.description: The same reservations by the code they carry in Stays, the one an operator reads, in the order of reservationIds. Empty under the same conditions as reservationIds, and shorter than it only for a payout stored before the sync began keeping the code, which the next sync of that payout completes.

netAmount.description: Amount of this reservation inside the payout, in the payout currency. The items add up to the payout netAmount once unattributedAmount, when present, is added to them.

grossAmount.description: Amount of this reservation before commissions and charges.

commissionAmount.description: Commissions and charges the OTA deducted from the gross amount of this reservation, signed: negative when the OTA returned them, which is what a cancellation or a resolution adjustment settled in this payout reports. grossAmount equals netAmount plus this amount, whichever the sign.

OtaPayout.description: A transfer sent by an OTA to the manager's bank account, with the breakdown by reservation.

payoutId.description: Identifier of the transaction in the OTA, as the OTA prints it on the bank side. Unique within its channel: the identity of a payout is the pair (channel, payoutId), and two channels may use the same value.

channel.description: OTA channel that sent the payout. Together with payoutId it identifies the payout.

currency.description: Currency of the payout. A payout is always single-currency.

netAmount.description: Amount that should appear in the bank account. It is the matching key of the reconciliation.

unattributedAmount.description: Share of netAmount that belongs to no reservation, signed: negative when the OTA deducted taxes the host remitted from the transfer, positive when the OTA added an amount that names no reservation. Present only when it is not zero. sum(items[].netAmount) + unattributedAmount equals netAmount.

grossAmount.description: Amount of the payout before commissions and charges.

commissionsAndCharges.description: Commissions and charges deducted from the gross amount, the sum of the items that report one. Signed, like the item amount it totals: a payout that only settles returned fees reports it negative. Absent when the sum is zero, which is also the case when no item reports a fee.

referenceDate.description: Base date of the batch in the OTA. Absent while the OTA has not reported a date for the batch, as with a Booking.com transfer still pending.

expectedAt.description: Date the OTA expects to settle the payout. Absent while the OTA has not reported it, as with a Booking.com transfer still pending.

paidAt.description: Date the payout was settled. Null while the payout is not paid.

items.description: Breakdown by reservation. Never empty. The items add up to netAmount once unattributedAmount, when present, is added to them.
